description.en: Announces the estimated spend per turn with bundled Dabaifan audio by default, with optional Alipay clips. Uses dsh-cost-meter when available, otherwise model-price estimates. All audio is bundled; no runtime speech synthesis.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束默认用内置的大白饭音频播报本轮估算花费，可选支付宝音色；优先取 dsh-cost-meter 金额，否则按模型单价估算。音频全部内置，运行时无需联网合成。
